<CLT=cltSYSTEM>In scenes where you have to deduce an image,
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Mind Mine<CLT=cltSYSTEM> will begin!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>In this mode, the objective is to
<CLT=cltSTRONG>dig up<CLT=cltSYSTEM> the <CLT=cltSTRONG>answer<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>At the beginning, the answer will be
completely <CLT=cltSTRONG>covered by pieces<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Use the <PAD=【Ｌ３】> stick to move the cursor
and <CLT=cltSTRONG>erase the pieces<CLT=cltSYSTEM> with the <PAD=【○】> button.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Pieces will be erased when
<CLT=cltSTRONG>two or more of the same color connect<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>adjacent pieces<CLT=cltSYSTEM> will then <CLT=cltSTRONG>change<CLT=cltSYSTEM> color
in the following order: <CLT=cltSTRONG>white, pink, yellow, white<CLT=cltSYSTEM>...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>If you do it right, you can remove
<CLT=cltSTRONG>all the pieces<CLT=cltSYSTEM> from an object.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>The trick is to <CLT=cltSTRONG>predict<CLT=cltSYSTEM> how the
adjacent pieces will change.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>When all the pieces on top of an object are
gone, you can <CLT=cltSTRONG>select the object<CLT=cltSYSTEM> as the answer.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>If you <CLT=cltSTRONG>select<CLT=cltSYSTEM> the wrong object,
your <CLT=cltSTRONG>Influence Gauge will take damage<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>If there's just one piece left, you can press
the <PAD=【○】> button repeatedly to break it.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>But that will incur a <CLT=cltSTRONG>time penalty<CLT=cltSYSTEM>,
so don't just button mash!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>It might sound complicated, but trust me,
you'll get it as you play.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Thank you for your understanding.
